page.overview:
Who is Alice Winters?

Alice Winters is a fictional Australian intelligence operative who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

Fascinated by the lifestyles of the wealthy women which she saw on the television, Alice began her long quest for luxury at an early age. Stowing away on a trading ship bound for Malaysia, she quickly learned to don a head scarf, lower her eyes and stay out of trouble. As she rose in power, she adopted a dual persona, splitting her time between acting as a meek, deferential, covered woman an a proud lioness clad in furs and gems. Notable for a vain personality, she has skills in deception, smuggling and firearms, and is multi-lingual, speaking English, Chinese, Japanese and Malay. The character offers a bonus to the finishing move threshold in Conflicts, with +10 total defence bonus with parabolic listening devices, +10 total defence bonus with laser wristwatches, +25 total offence bonus with royal enforcer pistols, and +50HP in Conflict and Villain fights using three-piece suits. She is an "epic agent" (purple) and can be levelled to level 35. While she is not part of the game's main plot, the character acts as a special event boss villain.
